name: contribution_key
description: sha256 of the aggregation key (recipient id, report, electoral event, contributor type, contributor name for non-individuals, contributor province). Primary key.

name: person_id
description: Linked person; NULL when status = 'ambiguous'.

name: status
description: linked | ambiguous. Ambiguous rows are never resolved by a person; the agent states the ambiguity.

name: candidates
description: person_ids that matched equally well (ambiguous rows only).

name: match_method
description: exact_name_term (name matches and the return's date is within a year of one of the person's terms) | exact_name_term_party (several namesakes fit; exactly one sat for the party named on the return).

name: confidence
description: 1.0 when linked, 0 for ambiguous.

name: political_entity
description: Elections Canada recipient kind: Candidates | Leadership contestants | Nomination contestants.

name: recipient_id
description: Elections Canada recipient id.

name: recipient_name
description: Recipient as filed ('Last, First').

name: recipient_party
description: Party of the recipient as filed.

name: electoral_district
description: District as filed. Context only.

name: electoral_event
description: e.g. '45th general election'; NULL for leadership/nomination contests.

name: report_date
description: Elections Canada 'Fiscal/Election date' of the return.

name: financial_report
description: Return name as filed.

name: contributor_type
description: Individuals | Businesses | Trade unions | ... as filed.

name: contributor_name
description: Organization name for non-individual contributors (pre-2007 businesses and unions). Always NULL for individuals: individual donors are aggregated, never named or located beyond province.

name: contributor_province
description: Two-letter province of the contributor as filed.

name: contribution_count
description: Number of contribution lines aggregated into this row.

name: monetary_total
description: Sum of 'Monetary amount' (CAD).

name: non_monetary_total
description: Sum of 'Non-Monetary amount' (CAD).

name: first_received
description: Earliest 'Contribution Received date' in the group, when filed.

name: last_received
description: Latest 'Contribution Received date' in the group, when filed.

name: source_object
description: gs:// URI of the Elections Canada archive the rows were read from.

name: run_id
description: Curate run that last wrote this row.
